name: Amoz
overview: Amoz is a male biblical figure known primarily as the father of the prophet Isaiah. Beyond this unique attribute, Scripture provides no additional details about his tribe or other distinguishing notes. His identity is significant mainly through his paternal connection to Isaiah.
namesAndTitles: The name Amoz means "strong," reflecting a proper name used in the biblical text. This name is not indicated as being given directly by God but is recorded in 2 Kings 19:2.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Amoz as the father of Isaiah, establishing a direct familial link to one of the major prophets. No other family relationships are recorded beyond this paternal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Amoz's importance in the biblical narrative stems from his role as the father of Isaiah, one of the most prominent prophets in Israel's history. His mention in 2 Kings 19:2 situates him within the historical context of Isaiah's prophetic ministry. Although Amoz himself does not appear as an active character, his legacy is carried forward through Isaiah's influential work in calling Israel to faithfulness.
